creator: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5) driving the owner's live Krita through the krita_mcp bridge
sourceMethod: 2560x1440 sRGB RGBA/8 Krita document built by bedroom_study_v2.py, a revision of the M1.0g bedroom_study.py with the same layout and coordinates. Changes: palette value range and saturation raised slightly; window-relative daylight (wall glow, projected pane sunlight on the floor, screen light shafts, soft-light warm bounce); stronger contact shadows; mattress lowered to 80 u and 36 u thick with piping and a lit rounded edge; duvet top gradient, fold ridges, cuff shadow and cast shadow on the rail; carved headboard bevels and cylinder-shaded posts; recessed door with lit jamb, panel bevels and wall shadow; the global paper-grain overlay removed in favour of clipped wood-grain streaks and fabric weave on wood and fabric only; lighter weighted warm lines (1.0 / 0.85 / 0.6 u). Rebuilt in one pass from the final script before saving.

layoutSource.method: Unchanged bedroom_layout_data.py (generated in M1.0g by a read-only import).
